provenance: Independent audit performed by openai/gpt-6.1-sol after quota-triggered fallback from anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5; original model did not perform the audit.
scope: All 54 EN/FR pairs, including all 12 V2-1 keys; meaning, register, grammar, plurals, ICU arguments, typography, move/remove/undo/Untagged/conflict semantics, and static copy length risk.

findings.description: The French many branch inserts de before conversations even though the count is rendered as digits, not the noun million. At count=1000000, actual IntlMessageFormat output starts: Retirez cette étiquette de 1000000 de conversations. Numeric French uses 1000000 conversations here; de conversations belongs after a spelled-out nominal million. Rare large-count grammatical defect; meaning remains clear.
findings.recommendation: For digit-formatted counts, use the same conversations suffix in many as in other; retain de only if formatting a spelled-out million.

findings.description: New move strings use ordinary U+0020 spaces inside French guillemets, unlike the existing U+202F narrow nonbreaking spaces in picker_title and delete_title. This allows a guillemet to separate from its quoted value at wrapping and is typographically inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Use U+202F inside these guillemets, consistent with the existing French catalogue.

evidence.icu_execution: Existing node dependencies IntlMessageFormat and @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser: parsed both catalogues, compared argument sets for every key, formatted all 54 French messages at counts 0,1,2,5,1000000,2000000 with synthetic name/title/tag/query. PASS 54/54; no missing arguments or parse failures.
evidence.plural_execution: remove_all: 1 => Retirer l’étiquette (1); 2 => Retirer toutes les étiquettes (2); 1000000 => Retirer toutes les étiquettes (1 000 000). French zero uses CLDR one; no ICU defect.
evidence.semantics: Étiquettes/Sans étiquette terminology consistent; Retirer distinguishes unassignment from Supprimer global tag deletion; primary-tag move, removal of all tags, move cancellation, undo, external modification, and retry messages preserve English intent. No untranslated English fallback accepted.
evidence.length_interpretation: French expansion warrants existing rendered locale coverage; character counts alone do not establish clipping. No actual clipping finding claimed.
